material.zh: 岷江 · 青衣江 · 大渡河

story.zh: 江面把城市的灯揉成一条条暖线，山影是冷的。暖色只留给按钮和状态灯。
story.en: City lights smeared into warm lines on the water; the hills stay cold. Warmth is reserved for buttons and state.

alt.zh: 乐山三江夜色（用户提供照片）

material.en: Cliff face at the evening bell

story.zh: 砂岩吸走最后一点日光，只剩金褐色的边。全套里唯一以暖色为主调的深色皮肤。
story.en: Sandstone holds the last daylight as a gold-brown edge — the only warm-led dark skin in the pack.

alt.zh: 乐山凌云山晚照（用户提供照片）

story.zh: 整夜都是蓝的：雾把山脊擦掉，只留下很低的对比和一条月色边线。
story.en: Blue all night: mist erases the ridge, leaving very low contrast and a thin moonlit edge.
